title: The Brief, August 1
text:
Updated Aug. 1, 2018 11:53 a.m. ET Careful Now. Don’t be fooled by the small decline in the Dow Jones Industrial Average. Without Apple (AAPL), which was surging after strong earnings , the blue-chip benchmark would be trading even lower after trade-war concerns heated up again . And don’t look now, but there’s a Fed statement coming this afternoon. Here are more things to know.
